title: The Why, What, and How of Pinning in Rust
summary: Jon Gjengset's long live-coding stream explains Rust's Pin and Unpin types: why they exist, how they work, and how they connect to futures and async/await. It also covers moving from pre-pinning code to the new model.
why: HN treats it as the definitive resource for understanding Pin semantics and lists it among async Rust learning materials.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Jon Gjengset's stream on pin/unpin is invaluable for understanding Pin semantics
